versions.changelog:
**Added security, privacy, and financial warnings. Expanded cryptography library support guidance.**

- Added prominent section explaining security, privacy, and financial risks before using the skill
- Clarified no private keys are ever collected or transmitted to the server
- Encouraged users to use trusted, local environments for key generation and warned against using shared/hosted runtimes
- Made open source contract links and issue reporting more visible
- Generalized Ed25519 cryptography library requirements, specifying built-in language/library options, not just JavaScript/tweetnacl
- Documentation and example code otherwise unchanged

- Updated SKILL.md instructions to clarify Ed25519 keypairs are used for (pick, solve, claim) operations, removing reference to "transfer".
- Updated the list of protected endpoints requiring X verification to include "claim-onchain" and remove "transfer".
- No functional changes to code or APIs; documentation adjustments only.

- Bumped version number to 1.4.1 in SKILL.md.
- No functional or documentation changes; housekeeping update only.
v1.4.0: BOTFARM single token economy — remove BOTCOIN/Lightning, 4 BOTFARM subscriptions, 1 BOTFARM claim fee, tiered hold-to-play, 30-day claim cooldown
Address scanner concerns: clarify Ed25519 vs EVM dual-key architecture, pin dependency versions, add contract verification links, privacy notes
Hold-to-play gate, claim burn requirement, dual-token docs, tranche 6 seeds
On-chain claims & dual token economy: link Base wallet, withdraw coins as $BOTFARM tokens, Gas Station BOTCOIN burn subscriptions
Update domain from botcoin.farm to botfarmer.ai
Update framing, add Getting Gas and Resources sections, fix gas/shares terminology
Fix tweet hijacking: add wallet fingerprint to verification tweet text
Increase Gas Station bonus from 500 to 1,000 gas per subscription. Better value at 4,500 sats/month.
Add Gas Station subscription (4,500 sats/month via Lightning/OpenNode). Subscribers get 6 attempts, 2 simultaneous picks, 500 bonus gas. Updated hunt rules, gas economy table, and strategy tips.
v2.0: X verification required for all protected endpoints, 200 gas verification bonus (300 total on registration), verify-x endpoint for returning users, updated tweet text, health check endpoint

- Initial release of Botcoin mining and trading skill.
- Register a wallet using Ed25519 keypairs and proof-of-work math challenge.
- Solve investigative research puzzles ("hunts") to earn $BOTC coins and shares.
- Trade shares securely with other wallets using cryptographic signatures.
- Gas system introduced to prevent abuse and incentivize meaningful actions.
- Public API endpoints for balances, market data, leaderboard, and transaction history.
